operators.name: add
semantics: Elementwise addition x + y, following torch.add semantics
Broadcasting not required because x and y have identical shape in all reference calls
Returns a new tensor with dtype float32 and device cuda

operators.name: argmin_dim
semantics: Computes torch.argmin(x, dim=-1, keepdim=True). The dim is always -1 in reference, keepdim always True.
Return type int64. For each row, finds index of minimum value. Ties broken by first occurrence (consistent with torch.argmin).
Output shape [batch,1] when keepdim=True as used.

operators.name: stft_complex
semantics: Computes short-time Fourier transform as torch.stft with default parameters: window=None (rectangular window), center=True, pad_mode='reflect', normalized=False, onesided=True, align_to_window=None.
n_freq = n_fft//2 + 1 = 513, n_frames = 1 + (length + 2*pad - n_fft)//hop_length where pad = n_fft//2 = 512, so n_frames = 1 + (200000+1024-1024)//256 = 782.
The implementation should exactly match torch.stft's algorithm: reflect padding, framing, optional window, FFT, one-sided extraction.
Output is complex64 tensor with shape [batch, n_freq, n_frames].
Elementwise addition of x and y, both float32, producing float32 tensor with shape [128,200000].
No broadcasting needed; output device cuda.
Computes argmin along last dimension, keepdim True, yielding int64 tensor shape [128,1].
For each row, index of minimum value; ties broken by first occurrence.

reference_steps.source: stft = torch.stft(x, n_fft=self.n_fft, hop_length=self.hop_length, win_length=self.win_length, return_complex=True)
semantics: STFT with n_fft=1024, hop_length=256, win_length=1024, return_complex=True.
Uses default rectangular window, center=True, pad_mode='reflect', normalized=False, onesided=True.
Output shape [128,513,782], dtype complex64, device cuda.
Returns tuple containing the three tensors in order: x (float32, [128,200000]), argmin (int64, [128,1]), stft (complex64, [128,513,782]).
